why:
I checked both must_catch items against the verifier brief, and neither is handled.

Item 1: Check 4 does say the line "cannot be satisfied at the PR head alone." But it then reads the live site with `curl ... https://o.github.io/greet-cli/` and reports FAIL ("not verifiable before merge") when the PR isn't merged. It never checks at the PR head what will publish the page. The --shout content of docs/index.md is checked only in Check 3, and pages.yml publishing docs/ from main appears only as an advisory note, not as part of Check 4.

Item 2: Check 2 compares the output against hand-written strings ("Before the change these print, respectively: `Hello, Ada!`..."). It never runs the base commit's bin/greet.js or otherwise gets the real output from before the change, so it only matches hand-written expected text.
